newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah softens on ample liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah softens on ample liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah softened against the dollar in early trading on Monday, dealers said.

"It's mainly the liquidity which is softening the rupiah," one local bank dealer said, adding that the dollar's uptrend was likely due to technical factors following a new bank reserve requirement rate of five percent implemented last Wednesday.
Spot rupiah fell to 2,412.5/13.0 at 0300 GMT from an opening 2,410.5/11.5. Today rupiah dropped to 2,412.0/13.0 from 2,409.8/10.8 on ample selling. Tomorrow was at 2,412.4/12.9.
Some dealers said a relatively tight dollar market appeared to be another reason for the rupiah's weakening.
The overnight dollar deposit rate edged up to 6.25 percent from a usual rate of around 5.50/5.75 percent.
But the local dealer said the condition was only temporary because operators had established large long dollar positions last week on the back of the ample rupiah market.
"If the dollar market is tight, overnight swaps would not have fallen into negative territory," he said, adding that overnight dollar was driven up by heavy buying in value today dollars.
The dealer said operators had to deal through the swap market to get dollars because of off-balance sheet regulations.
One-month swaps edged down to 10.25/10.50 from 11.50/11.75 last Thursday, two to 22.0/23.0 from 24.0/25.0, three to 33.75/34.50 from 35.5/36.5 and six to 70.5/71.5 from 71.5/72.5.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention band by one point to 2,402/2,594 and the conversion band to 2,402/2,450 on Thursday.
The market was closed last Friday for a Muslim holiday.
He said the conversion of the dollar rate at 6.25 percent and overnight money at nine percent still offered some premiums, but overnight swaps were being traded at -0.10/-0.05 points.
"This suggests some banks are hitting off-balance sheet limits, driving overnight swaps down. The dollar market is not really tight. I think it's only temporary," he added.
"What we see is there is more swaps unloading than direct borrowing of dollars," the dealer said. Tom/next swap was at 0.05/0.10 points. Swap premiums were lower across the board.
